relationships.subject: Limosilactobacillus reuteri RE225
relationships.evidence_quote: Intervention with L. reuteri RE225 also suppressed the TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)/heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) pathways in the mice

relationships.subject: Limosilactobacillus reuteri RE225
relationships.evidence_quote: and increased the level of the anti-inflammatory cytokine interleukin 10 (IL-10), thereby mitigating inflammation

key_findings: L. reuteri RE225 reduced foot swelling and pain in gout mice and improved gut microbiota.
It suppressed TLR4/MyD88/NF-kB and Nrf2/HO-1 pathways and lowered IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha.
